title: 8 Things a Godly Man Forgives in You Before He Forgives in Himself
caption:
8 things a godly man forgives in you before he forgives in himself. He's still working on believing it for himself.

He let your mistake go days ago. His own from three years back still visits at night. He gives you the benefit of the doubt and gives himself none. He calls your hard season a hard year. He calls his own a character flaw.

He hands out the grace freely. He just never signs for his own delivery.

The grace you extend to others is real. Let it teach you something about the God who extends it to you too.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #grace #selfcompassion #discipleship
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
